manifest.hypothesis: with per-layer chain keys, layers below a LoRA's first adapted layer share base KV pages bit-identically, and aLoRA prefixes reuse base KV exactly, evaluated on at least one configuration with 0 < f < L (pinned f = L/2); configurations with f = 0 alone cannot pass; the predicted sharing fraction is per adapter type: a QKV-LoRA first attached at layer f shares f/L, a Q-only or MLP-only adapter at f shares (f+1)/L, and an aLoRA shares all full pre-invocation pages plus the pre-invocation rows of the boundary page; the pinned run covers QKV-LoRA, Q-only, MLP-only and aLoRA, with QKV-LoRA and Q-only each run at f = L/2 and at f = 0, including an aLoRA whose invocation point lies inside a 16-token page (offset 7); the adapter request's logits are bit-identical to a full adapter prefill; the claim is a KV-memory saving only (a forward-compute saving would need a layer-boundary residual cache, which is out of scope, so no prefill-FLOPs claim is made); chain keys isolate adapters and generations (adapter A's entry is never hit by adapter B, nor an old generation by the new one); semantic-input lineage is enforced; the bitwise claims use seeded random weights with a pinned seed and shape; lagging or lost invalidation and restore or restart never expose stale entries; dependency invalidation (J0): an explicit revocation or a committed supersession, i.e. a generation replacement or edit, of any generation-bearing dependency; every protective mechanism of this experiment triggers on any invalidation, for the dependency kinds it covers (adapter generations and semantic inputs); Derived segments are generation-bearing dependencies like semantic and memory inputs: the closed list of dependency kinds is semantic, memory, derived, base model, adapter and expert, narrowed here to the kinds this workload has (see dependency_list_narrowing_reason), and any future generation-bearing segment kind joins by definition.

invalidation_matrix_cases < 1 for any cell of invalidation_coverage_matrix (config.toml enumerates all 40 cells: dependency kind x invalidation type x path; each cell recorded and required per cell, never as an aggregate); model_pin_mismatches > 0 (the base checkpoint (repo and revision), the tokenizer (repo and revision) or the initial MoE topology recorded in run.json differs from the pin in config.toml, or the tiny-model config digest differs).
